scoring: Five 1..20 dimensions summed to 5..100. Old20 original nonblind grades preserved; new30 initial scoring masks condition labels but same-session model review is not independent blind judging. Not accuracy, not the paper judge.
failed_generations: Retained in completion denominator; rubric mean denominator explicitly scored_answers; failures have null grades.
inference_limits: Four selected repositories only, public questions, old20 already used for development; report cohorts separately. Cluster intervals have only four clusters. Observed elapsed time uses warm retrieval caches and GPU model swapping, not cold-start performance.
